chunks: Al-Sadiq, peace be upon him, said:
“There is no one whose death is more beloved to Iblis than the death of a faqih.”

key_terms.إِبْلِيسَ: Iblis, the satanic enemy of human guidance
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the speaker of the hadith
key_terms.فَقِيهٍ: a jurist-scholar possessing deep understanding of religion
key_terms.مَوْتِ: death, the passing away of a person

ai.seo_question: Why is the death of a faqih especially beloved to Iblis?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام teaches the immense value of the faqih by stating that Iblis most rejoices at the death of such a person. The hadith highlights the central role of religious knowledge and its bearers in protecting the community from misguidance.
